topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 28 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 11 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 4 functional families. Its contracts share 26 common project-authored base contract(s) (stratauth, auth, ibase). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
